macros.name: amu
macros.doc: \amu is a macro for atomic mass units (amu).

macros.name: au
macros.doc: \au is a macro for astronmical units (au).

macros.name: BTU
macros.doc: \BTU is a macro for British Thermal Units (BTU).

macros.name: Celsius
macros.doc: \Celsius is a macro for degrees Celsius ( ◦ C).

macros.name: erg
macros.doc: \erg is a macro for ergs (erg), the unit of energy in cgs.

macros.name: esu
macros.doc: \esu is a macro for electrostatic units (esu), the units of charge in Gaussian cgs.

macros.name: eV
macros.doc: \eV is a macro for electron Volts (eV).

macros.name: Fahrenheit
macros.doc: \Fahrenheit is a macro for degrees Fahrenheit ( ◦ F).

macros.name: ftpss
macros.doc: \ftpss is a macro for acceleration in feet per second squared ( ft s−2 ).

macros.name: gacc
macros.doc: \gacc is a macro for acceleration due to gravity ( g).

macros.name: Gauss
macros.doc: \Gauss is a macro for Gauss (G), the units for magnetic field strength in Gaussian cgs.

macros.name: hpi
macros.doc: \hpi is a macro for Imperial Horsepower (hp(I)).

macros.name: inHg
macros.doc: \inHg is a macro for inches of mercury (inHg).

macros.name: keV
macros.doc: \keV is a macro for kilo-electron Volts (keV).

macros.name: kmph
macros.doc: \kmph is a macro for kilometers per hour ( km h−1 ).

macros.name: kmps
macros.doc: \kmps is a macro for kilometers per second ( km s−1 ).

macros.name: kts
macros.doc: \kts is a macro for knots ( kts).

macros.name: lbf
macros.doc: \lbf is a macro for pounds of force (lbf).

macros.name: lbsf
macros.doc: \lbsf is a macro for pounds per square foot (psf).

macros.name: lbsi
macros.doc: \lbsi is a macro for pounds per square inch (psi).

macros.name: MeV
macros.doc: \MeV is a macro for mega-electron Volts (MeV).

macros.name: micro
macros.doc: \micro is a special macro that can be used for the prefix μ (micro-).

macros.name: miph
macros.doc: \miph is a macro for miles per hour ( mi h−1 ).

macros.name: mmHg
macros.doc: \mmHg is a macro for millimeters of mercury (mmHg).

macros.name: mps
macros.doc: \mps is a macro for meters per second ( m s−1 ).

macros.name: mpss
macros.doc: \mpss is a macro for acceleration in meters per second squared ( m s−2 ).

macros.name: Rankine
macros.doc: \Rankine is a macro for degrees Rankine ( ◦ R).

macros.name: rpm
macros.doc: \rpm is a macro for revolutions per minute ( rev min−1 ).

macros.name: tnt
macros.doc: \tnt is a macro for tons of TNT.
